description: Implementation of DefaultDecoderFactory class for creating audio and video decoders in media rendering, with conditional compilation for different decoder types and platform-specific features.

classes.name: DefaultDecoderFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating audio and video decoders, supporting external decoders and platform-specific features.

methods.name: CreateAudioDecoders
methods.description: Creates and adds audio decoders to the provided vector, including platform-specific and external decoders.

methods.name: CreateVideoDecoders
methods.description: Creates and adds video decoders to the provided vector, including platform-specific, hardware-accelerated, and external decoders.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the factory instance.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the factory, releasing resources and preventing further decoder creation.
